Kitchen Friends

A soft, sunny kitchen where the helpers are alive: the pot, the bowls and the jars all have friendly faces. Pastel colours, round shapes, hearts and stars. Calm and cuddly, best for younger chefs (about 5 to 8).

Why a child would want to play this one

  • The kitchen smiles back. Helpers with faces react to what the child does, the same way Sprig does. Food itself has no face, so chopping never feels mean.
  • One clear thing in every bowl. Each ingredient is a tidy heap or three big pieces with a number badge, never a crowded pile.
  • Rewards to keep. Stars for each dish and a sticker book that fills up, so there is always one more to collect.
  • No way to lose. A mistake just means “try again”; nothing is taken away.
